about: What the json-said region reads a JSON document as, in two worlds: a place of the tree and a published folder. What it emits over these cases is the reader: an edit that emits the same over them is the same reader and keeps what it read.

The cases are four samples and a vector as the reader was handed them: one that says its title, brief and about, one that says only its about, one that says nothing of itself but its cases, one that carries lines of the wire, said joined as its about is, and a vector whose cases name the moves between its states and whose law says which of them are dangerous.
